verdict_reason: The one-line switch to commodityCode is correct, but the silent skip-the-page redirect it now drives has no log line and the file carries rationale comments.

todos.issue: noIdentifiersTarget (lines 79-82, used at 86-88 and 95-97) redirects past the page with no log line. identifiedLines (line 36) now decides this by looking up the stored MDM commodityCode in the hard-coded COMMODITY_IDENTIFIERS table, so a code that does not match exactly (for example the '010619' vs '01061900' form raised in the ticket comments) silently skips identification and support cannot tell why a notification has no identifiers
todos.fix: Must: the skip-the-page branch logs once, at info, with the journey id and the commodity codes on the lines it found nothing to identify on. One way: log inside noIdentifiersTarget when it returns a target, passing { journeyId, commodityCodes }

todos.issue: Rationale comments in code: lines 47-49 explain why the recap shows the whole consignment ('hiding it invites the trader to add the commodity a second time'), and lines 76-78 explain why the page does not exist and describe its callers ('The guard sits on both handlers'). House rule: rationale goes in docs or the behaviour spec, and a comment never describes callers
todos.fix: Must: no rationale or caller-describing comments in the controller; the names say what the code does. One way: delete both comments, rename allLines to e.g. everyCommodityLine if the distinction needs saying, and move the rationale to the identification-details behaviour spec if it is not already there
